outcome: Frequency of manual adjustments of FiO2
cohort: Preterm infants with a gestational age less than 33 weeks who received supplemental oxygen and either invasive or non-invasive respiratory support within the first 24 hours of life.
finding: The use of closed-loop automatic control of FiO2 was associated with fewer manual adjustments, fewer episodes of hypoxemia and hyperoxemia, and increased time spent within the target SpO2 range compared to routine manual control.
